turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, Dadaji? It is me, Rohan. Please do not be shocked, but I am in a very bad situation.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Rohan? Beta, is that you? Your voice sounds different, what happened?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I had a small accident here in Chennai and the police are holding me because of some paperwork issues. I am very scared, Mr. Gupta, please help me.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Accident? My goodness! Why are you calling me and not your father?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is the problem, I do not want to worry Papa or he will be furious with me. Please, you must keep this a secret between us for now.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: But how can I keep such a big thing secret? Are you hurt?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am fine, but the lawyer says I need to pay a bail bond immediately or I will stay in lockup all weekend. I need eighty thousand rupees urgently.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? That is a lot of money, I have to check my savings account first.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please hurry, Dadaji, the officer is asking for the payment right now. Can you send it via UPI or bank transfer immediately?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I do not know how to do this fast, let me call your uncle first to ask for help.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, no! Do not call anyone or they will tell Papa and I will be in more trouble. Just send the money to this number I will message you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am getting very confused, let me just hang up and call your father's phone.
